controls.statement: Every data set has an owner and classification.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Given an authoritative inventory, ownership and classification are exact required fields whose presence and allowed values can be checked for every listed data set.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative data-set inventory enumerates every in-scope data set by stable identifier.
Every inventoried data set has a nonempty owner identifier and a classification value allowed by the versioned classification policy.

controls.statement: Referential integrity is enforced or continuously checked.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: With a complete relationship inventory and an approved check cadence, each relationship can be matched exactly to a database constraint or authenticated continuous-check evidence.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative relationship inventory enumerates every in-scope referential relationship and its allowed integrity mechanism.
Each inventoried relationship has either a matching enforced constraint or a current integrity-check job meeting the approved cadence.

controls.statement: Poison messages cannot block an entire queue indefinitely.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Complete queue configuration plus a bounded poison-message exercise can establish finite retry or isolation behavior without interpreting business quality.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every queue has an authoritative finite retry, quarantine, dead-letter, or discard policy that prevents one message from remaining the active head indefinitely.
A bounded poison-message exercise shows later eligible messages continue or the poison message is isolated within the approved limit.

controls.statement: Search-index freshness and reconciliation are monitored.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: For a complete search-index inventory, freshness and reconciliation monitor bindings, enabled state, and current signal health can be checked exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative search-index inventory lists every in-scope index and its approved freshness and reconciliation signals.
Each inventoried index has active authoritative monitors for both approved signal types with current data.

controls.statement: Date and time values use an unambiguous storage representation.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: An approved time-storage contract can define unambiguous representations, after which every inventoried date and time field can be compared exactly with that allowlist.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: A versioned time-storage contract defines allowed representations including timezone, precision, and normalization requirements.
Every date or time field in the authoritative schema inventory uses an allowed representation from that contract.

controls.statement: Data quality indicators cover completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness, and duplication.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: The five named data-quality dimensions are a closed set, so an authoritative indicator registry can be checked for at least one owned indicator mapped to each dimension.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The data-quality indicator registry contains owned indicators mapped to completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness, and duplication.

controls.statement: Orphaned data and references are detected.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Given a complete relationship inventory, an authenticated orphan-detection query or job and its current result can be verified for every relationship.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every relationship in the authoritative inventory links to an exact orphan-detection query or job definition.
Each linked detector has current authenticated execution evidence and reports its orphan count explicitly.

controls.statement: Manual production data changes require authorization and an audit trail.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: With a complete production change-event source, each manual data change can be matched exactly to prior authorization and an immutable audit event.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Authoritative production audit evidence identifies every manual data-change event by actor, target, and time.
Every identified event references a valid prior authorization and an immutable audit record of the resulting change.

controls.statement: Every migration has a reviewed plan.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: A complete migration inventory can be joined exactly to versioned plans and authenticated review decisions for each migration.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every migration in the authoritative migration inventory links to a nonempty plan and a completed review record identifying reviewer and revision.

controls.statement: Migration duration and resource consumption are measured.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Authenticated migration test evidence can report elapsed time and resource metrics as exact measurements without deciding whether the values are acceptable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The latest representative migration test transcript records elapsed duration and the approved CPU, memory, storage, lock, and I/O resource metrics.

controls.statement: A backup or recovery point exists before destructive changes.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Destructive migrations and recovery points have authoritative timestamps, so every destructive change can be checked for a usable preceding backup or recovery-point record.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The migration inventory marks every destructive change and records its execution time.
Each destructive change has authenticated evidence of an approved recovery point created and verified before execution.

controls.statement: Migration progress and failures are observable.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: For each inventoried migration, required progress and failure signals can be matched to telemetry definitions and verified by a bounded success-and-failure exercise.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every migration defines progress and failure telemetry with stable signal identifiers.
A bounded exercise produces both the declared progress signal and the declared failure signal in authoritative monitoring evidence.

controls.statement: Deprecated columns, data, and indexes are removed only after all consumers have migrated.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: With a complete consumer registry and immutable migration events, removal time can be compared exactly with every consumer's recorded migration completion time.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative registry enumerates every consumer of each deprecated column, datum, and index.
No removal event precedes the authenticated migration-complete event for any registered consumer.

controls.statement: Data migrations are rehearsed using the same automation used for production.
heading_trail: 23. Data model, databases, queues, caches, and integrity
controls.primary_reason: Authenticated rehearsal and production provenance can be compared by immutable automation artifact digest, making use of the same automation objectively decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The rehearsal record identifies the executed migration automation by immutable artifact digest.
The production execution record identifies the same immutable artifact digest as the rehearsal record.

controls.statement: Record the source, purpose, lawful basis or authorization, recipients, location, retention, and deletion method for each category.
controls.primary_reason: For every category in the authoritative privacy inventory, the nine named metadata fields or governed alternatives can be checked for required values and resolvable references.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Each inventoried personal-data category records source, purpose, lawful-basis or authorization reference, recipients, location, retention, and deletion method.

controls.statement: New data uses have undergone privacy review.
controls.primary_reason: Once new data uses are authoritatively registered, each can be matched exactly to a completed privacy-review decision for the same revision before activation.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The change registry identifies every newly introduced data use and its activation time.
Each registered use references a completed privacy-review decision for the same revision dated before activation.

controls.statement: Rights-response deadlines are tracked.
controls.primary_reason: Given approved deadline rules and complete request records, due dates, current status, and overdue tracking can be computed exactly for every request.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved policy maps each applicable request type and jurisdiction to an exact deadline calculation rule.
Every rights request has authenticated received, due, completed, and status timestamps sufficient to identify overdue work.

controls.statement: Retention periods are explicit.
controls.primary_reason: Retention periods are explicit when each authoritative data category has a machine-readable duration or event-based rule rather than an empty or indefinite placeholder.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every category in the authoritative data inventory has a nonempty, machine-readable retention duration or event-based retention rule.

controls.statement: Privacy contacts and escalation paths exist.
controls.primary_reason: The existence of privacy contacts and escalation paths is exactly checkable through resolvable owner identifiers, current contact routes, and a defined escalation sequence.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative privacy-contact record names a primary contact, backup or escalation owner, reachable route, and ordered escalation path.

controls.statement: Test accounts and deleted users do not remain indefinitely in downstream tools.
controls.primary_reason: With complete downstream account mappings and an approved finite lifetime, account age and deletion status can be evaluated exactly against the policy.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative downstream inventory maps test accounts and deleted-user identities to every receiving tool.
No mapped test account or deleted-user record exceeds the approved maximum retention age without an authorized hold.

controls.statement: Frontend and backend budgets are documented.
controls.primary_reason: Frontend and backend budgets are documented when the authoritative performance policy contains explicit owned threshold records for both applicable layers.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The performance policy contains nonempty frontend and backend budget records with metric, threshold, unit, scope, and owner.

controls.statement: Baseline performance is recorded before launch.
controls.primary_reason: A launch baseline is an exact timestamped record, so its existence and pre-launch ordering can be verified without judging whether the measured value is good.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every launch record references authenticated baseline measurements captured before the launch timestamp for the approved performance metrics.

controls.statement: Public pages meet approved loading, interaction, and visual-stability targets.
controls.primary_reason: A complete public-page inventory, approved numeric targets, and authenticated measurements allow loading, interaction, and visual-stability results to be compared exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every public page in the authoritative inventory has approved numeric loading, interaction, and visual-stability targets.
Current authenticated measurements for every inventoried page satisfy each target using the approved measurement protocol.

controls.statement: API latency targets are defined per endpoint or journey.
controls.primary_reason: For a complete endpoint and journey inventory, the presence of a scoped numeric latency target and percentile can be checked exactly for every entry.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every endpoint or journey in the authoritative performance inventory has a machine-readable latency target with percentile, threshold, unit, and scope.

controls.statement: Database-query latency and volume are measured.
controls.primary_reason: For an authoritative database inventory, active query-latency and query-volume measurements can be verified by stable metric identifiers and current telemetry samples.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every production database has declared query-latency and query-volume metric identifiers.
Authoritative monitoring contains current samples for both declared metrics for every database.

controls.statement: Payload sizes are bounded.
controls.primary_reason: Approved payload-size limits can be joined to every inventoried interface and compared with schema limits or bounded maximum-size execution evidence.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every payload-producing interface in the authoritative inventory has an approved numeric size limit.
Schema enforcement or bounded execution evidence proves each inventoried interface rejects or constrains payloads at its approved limit.

controls.statement: Cold-start performance is acceptable.
controls.primary_reason: With an approved cold-start scenario, numeric acceptance threshold, and authenticated test evidence, cold-start performance is an exact threshold comparison.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The performance policy defines the cold-start state, workload, metric, percentile, and numeric acceptance threshold.
Authenticated execution evidence from that exact protocol meets the approved cold-start threshold.

controls.statement: Third-party script and service impact is measured.
controls.primary_reason: For a complete third-party inventory and an approved measurement protocol, enabled-versus-disabled impact measurements can be checked for every service exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every third-party script or service in the authoritative inventory has an approved impact-measurement protocol and metric set.
Authenticated measurement evidence records the impact result for every inventoried third party.

controls.statement: Performance regressions have automated release thresholds.
controls.primary_reason: Release-gate definitions can be inspected for exact numeric performance thresholds and authenticated CI evidence can show the gate blocks a deliberately failing fixture.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative release pipeline defines automated numeric thresholds for every approved regression metric.
A bounded gate test proves an over-threshold fixture causes the release gate to fail.

controls.statement: Forecast normal, peak, burst, launch, seasonal, and abuse traffic.
controls.primary_reason: The six named traffic conditions form a closed documentation requirement, so forecast records can be checked for numeric values, units, horizons, and owners for each condition.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The capacity forecast records normal, peak, burst, launch, seasonal, and abuse traffic with value, unit, time horizon, source, and owner.

controls.statement: Forecast data, file, index, queue, log, and backup growth.
controls.primary_reason: The seven named growth dimensions can be checked exactly for nonempty numeric forecasts, units, horizons, assumptions, and owners.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The capacity forecast records data, file, index, queue, log, and backup growth with value, unit, time horizon, assumption, and owner.

controls.statement: Load tests include authentication and authorization overhead.
controls.primary_reason: Authentication and authorization overhead is included when the versioned load-test scenario executes real approved identity and permission paths and records their enabled state.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authenticated load-test transcript shows the approved authentication and authorization paths enabled for every scenario that requires them.

controls.statement: Load tests include external dependency behavior.
controls.primary_reason: External dependency behavior is included when every dependency in the scenario contract has a versioned real or simulated behavior profile referenced by the executed load test.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The load-test transcript references an exact behavior profile for every external dependency listed in the approved scenario contract.

controls.statement: Stress testing identifies how the system fails beyond capacity.
controls.primary_reason: A versioned stress test can objectively show operation beyond the approved capacity boundary and record the resulting failure mode and first breached invariant.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Authenticated stress-test evidence exceeds the approved capacity boundary and records throughput, saturation point, failure mode, and first breached safety or service threshold.

controls.statement: Capacity testing includes the largest expected tenant or customer.
controls.primary_reason: An authoritative largest-tenant forecast and the executed test fixture can be compared by exact size and shape fields to prove the scenario was included.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved capacity forecast identifies the largest expected tenant or customer profile with machine-readable size dimensions.
Authenticated capacity-test evidence uses a fixture meeting or exceeding every declared profile dimension.

controls.statement: Provider quotas and account limits have been reviewed.
controls.primary_reason: For a complete provider-resource inventory, current quota values and account limits can be joined exactly to dated review records and resolvable owners.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every provider resource in the authoritative inventory records its quota and account-limit identifiers.
Current authoritative quota values exist and each resource links to a completed, dated review record.

controls.statement: Database connections, locks, storage, replicas, and I/O have sufficient headroom.
controls.primary_reason: Approved numeric headroom policies and current authoritative utilization metrics make headroom for each named database resource an exact calculation.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The database capacity policy defines numeric required headroom for connections, locks, storage, replicas, and I/O.
Current authenticated capacity evidence shows each required database resource meets its approved headroom threshold.

controls.statement: Queue, cache, load-balancer, network, and worker capacity have sufficient headroom.
controls.primary_reason: Approved numeric headroom policies and current metrics make sufficiency for queue, cache, load-balancer, network, and worker capacity exactly decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The platform capacity policy defines numeric required headroom for queues, caches, load balancers, networks, and workers.
Current authenticated capacity evidence shows each required platform resource meets its approved headroom threshold.

controls.statement: Autoscaling minimums, maximums, triggers, cooldowns, and scale-down behavior are validated.
controls.primary_reason: Autoscaling configuration fields can be extracted and a bounded scale-up and scale-down protocol can validate the declared triggers, cooldowns, limits, and behavior.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every autoscaler has explicit minimum, maximum, trigger, cooldown, and scale-down settings in authoritative configuration.
Authenticated bounded tests confirm scale-up and scale-down occur at the declared triggers without exceeding configured limits or cooldown rules.

controls.statement: Scaling does not overload a database or dependency.
controls.primary_reason: Within an approved scaling envelope, complete dependency limits plus an authenticated scale test allow peak observed load to be compared exactly against every limit.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The scaling contract records the approved scaling envelope and numeric overload limits for every database and dependency it can pressure.
Authenticated scale-test evidence covers the envelope and remains within every declared database and dependency limit.

controls.statement: Capacity remains sufficient during a zone, node, or region failure according to the design.
controls.primary_reason: The design supplies the failure scenario and required capacity thresholds, so authenticated zone, node, or region failure evidence can be compared to them exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved resilience design defines applicable zone, node, or region loss scenarios and numeric capacity requirements for each.
Authenticated failure-test or environment evidence shows remaining capacity satisfies every declared scenario requirement.

controls.statement: Queues are bounded or have explicit overload behavior.
controls.primary_reason: For a complete queue inventory, each queue can be checked for a numeric bound or an explicit machine-readable overload action and exercised at that boundary.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every queue in the authoritative inventory has either a numeric capacity bound or an explicit overload behavior.
A bounded execution test confirms the declared overload behavior activates at the configured boundary.

controls.statement: DDoS scenarios and provider protections have been reviewed.
controls.primary_reason: For an authoritative edge and provider inventory, DDoS scenario records and completed protection-review decisions can be matched exactly to each exposed surface.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every exposed service in the authoritative edge inventory links to at least one versioned DDoS scenario and its provider-protection configuration.
Each linked scenario and protection configuration has a completed, dated review record with a resolvable owner.

controls.statement: The cost of expected and peak operation has been modeled.
controls.primary_reason: Expected and peak operating cost models are exact required records whose inputs, horizon, currency, outputs, owner, and revision can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The capacity cost model records expected and peak scenarios with input assumptions, time horizon, currency, computed cost, owner, and review date.

controls.statement: Cost limits do not silently terminate essential operation.
controls.primary_reason: For every essential operation declared by policy, cost-enforcement configuration and a bounded over-limit test can prove the operation is not silently terminated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved service policy identifies every essential operation and its permitted behavior when cost limits are reached.
A bounded over-limit test confirms each essential operation follows its declared behavior and emits a visible signal rather than silently terminating.

controls.statement: Capacity assumptions have owners and review dates.
controls.primary_reason: Owner identifiers and review dates are exact fields, so every capacity assumption in an authoritative registry can be checked for both values and date validity.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every capacity assumption has a resolvable owner and a valid next-review date in the authoritative capacity registry.
